name: ShowMeYourName
description: Display any permutation of custom nicknames, friend nicknames, server nicknames, display names, and usernames in chat.

settings.label: Messages
settings.description: Display custom name format in messages.

settings.label: Replies
settings.description: Display custom name format in replies.

settings.label: Discriminators
settings.description: Append discriminators to usernames for bots. Discriminators were deprecated for users, but are still used for bots. By default, a bot's username is equivalent to a user's global name, therefore multiple bots can have the same username. Appending discriminators makes them unique again.

settings.label: Remove duplicates
settings.description: If any of the names are equivalent, remove them, leaving only the unique names.

settings.label: Name separator
settings.description: The separator to use between names. The default is a single space.

settings.label: Friend names only in DMs
settings.description: Only display friend names when in DMs, and not in servers.

settings.label: Custom names only in DMs
settings.description: Only display custom names when in DMs, and not in servers.

settings.label: Included names
settings.description: The order to display usernames, display names, nicknames, friend names, and custom names. Use the following placeholders: {user}, {display}, {nick}, {friend}, {custom}. You can provide multiple name options to use as fallbacks if one is unavailable by separating them with commas as such: {custom, friend, nick}. You can have up to three prefixes and three suffixes per name.

gaps: Names in mentions, the typing indicator, the member list, DMs and friends lists, autocomplete, profiles, voice channels and reaction tooltips: Qord has no name surface there yet (upstream settings mentions, typingIndicator, memberList, searchAutocomplete, profilePopout, voiceChannels, reactions).
Per-name colours and Nitro display-name styles (upstream's colour, font, effect, gradient and style* settings): Qord draws the whole name in the author's role colour.
hideDefaultAtSign: Qord's reply previews show names without an @.
notes: Qord has no Streamer Mode, so upstream's truncateAllNamesWithStreamerMode has nothing to do. Custom nicknames are kept in the plugin's settings instead of upstream's DataStore.
